## Terms and definitions
**Certified widget** : a widget complying with this regulation.
**Performance class** : classification P1, P2, P3 per ARF §3.1.
**Load test** : mechanical test measuring maximum sustained load in Newtons.

<!-- SECTION: Article 6 — Cryptographic parameters | STATUS: PRIMARY | AGENT: agent-algo -->
## Article 6 — Cryptographic parameters
Cryptographic parameters used in widget firmware shall comply with the
approved algorithm list defined in ARF §3.2.
Key length shall meet the minimum values specified in ARF Table 3.2-1.
Use of deprecated algorithms constitutes a non-conformity.

<!-- SECTION: §3.1 — Performance class definitions | STATUS: CONTEXT | PRIMARY-AGENT: none (thesaurus) -->
## §3.1 — Performance class definitions
P1: high-load industrial use (≥500 N).
P2: standard commercial use (≥300 N).
P3: light domestic use (≥150 N).

<!-- SECTION: §3.2 — Approved algorithm list | STATUS: PRIMARY | AGENT: agent-algo -->
## §3.2 — Approved algorithm list

| Algorithm | Min key length (bits) | Status    |
|-----------|----------------------|-----------|
| AES       | 128                  | approved  |
| RSA       | 2048                 | approved  |
| ECC       | 256                  | approved  |
| DES       | 56                   | deprecated |
| 3DES      | 112                  | deprecated |

A widget firmware using a deprecated algorithm shall be marked non-compliant.
A widget firmware using an approved algorithm with insufficient key length
shall be marked non-compliant.

<!-- SECTION: §4.1 — Implementation guidance | STATUS: CONTEXT | PRIMARY-AGENT: none (CORPUS-DIRECTIVES: no_auto_rules — override, marker absent in source) -->
## §4.1 — Implementation guidance
Implementations should select algorithms appropriate to the security
context and threat model, considering lifecycle and operational constraints.
The choice of algorithm family should reflect the intended deployment environment.
